Take the lead in operations at Skechers and guide your teams toward excellence in a fully automated and fast-growing environment!

Skechers USA is a global leader in lifestyle and performance footwear, generating $9 billion in annual revenue. The company designs, develops, and markets over 3,000 styles for men, women, and children.

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package
• The extra perk? An on-site gym with a personal coach
To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

 

 

Jobomschrijving

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture.
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments.
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs.
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners.
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills:

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment.
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).
• Strong working knowledge of English.
Your personality and soft skills:

• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment.
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen.
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges.
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions.
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company

• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations

• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities

• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles

• Supervise external contractors and service providers

You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field

• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics

• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)

• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written

• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp

Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

An leading independent law firm based in Brussels and London is searching for an administrative assistant.

Jobomschrijving

As a trilingual Administrative Assistant, you are the seamless link between teams, clients and leaders — elevating communication, efficiency and collaboration across every

Document & Information Management

Create, format and refine documents and timesheets with accuracy and attention to detail.

Update and maintain the contact database to ensure flawless information flow.

Edit and manage office floorplans when needed.

Meetings & Events Coordination

Organize meetings and conference calls, ensuring smooth logistics from start to finish.

Provide support for both internal and external events, contributing to their seamless execution.

Reception Support

Act as backup for reception:

Second floor: during lunch breaks, holidays and receptionist absences.

First floor: during client meetings.

You’re a sharp, fast-moving administrative powerhouse who keeps everything — and everyone — on track. Fully fluent in English, French and Dutch, you switch between languages with ease, making communication smooth and effortless across the entire organization.

You love bringing order to chaos: calendars run better, documents look sharper, and operations flow smoother because you’re behind them. Detail-driven but always thinking two steps ahead, you anticipate needs before they appear and handle challenges with confidence and positivity.

People count on you because you deliver — with efficiency, professionalism and a smile.

You’re proactive, reliable and naturally service-minded, making you the go-to person for both colleagues and clients. In short: you’re the kind of assistant who makes the whole office work better.

You will:

• Deliver an exceptional customer experience through personalised service.
• Build strong customer relationships and develop customer loyalty.
• Actively contribute to achieving individual and store KPIs.
• Work closely with your colleagues to achieve team objectives.
• Represent our premium image and maintain excellent visual merchandising standards.
• Help create an inspiring shopping environment in our brand-new boutique.

• Speak fluent French and English is a strong advantage

Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.

You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

No diploma required.

Good knowledge of English

You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports. 
 
• You ensure all activities follow guidelines and internal procedures. 
 
• You maintain accurate data in electronic systems for the assigned studies. 
 
• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed.

• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing).

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
